curl -XPUT -u fedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin http://vm1:8080/fedora/objects/test:pid/datastreams/testdsid?dsLabel="wallawalla"

I get back a datastream profile and everything is fine.

When I run:
curl -XPUT -u fedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin http://vm1:8080/fedora/objects/test:pid/datastreams/DC?dsLabel="wallawalla"

I get back:
InputStream cannot be null
